title: Training Notes: Membership-Age Uplift on Crestline Companion Phone Fee Refunds
content:
**What is the membership-age uplift?** An uplift on a Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes phone booking fee refund that follows how long the holder has been a member of the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program: the whole calendar months from the enrolled date of the holder's Summit membership to the handling date.

**How much does it add?**

| Whole calendar months from the enrolled date to the handling date | Membership-age uplift |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | adds 10 percent |
| 60 to fewer than 120 | adds 5 percent |
| fewer than 60 | adds nothing |

**Where is the enrolled date read?** On the holder's Summit membership record, as the date the membership was opened.

**Where do the boundaries fall?** A membership enrolled on 10 June 2016 reaches 120 whole months on 10 June 2026 (10 percent) and has 119 on 9 June 2026 (5 percent). One enrolled on 10 June 2021 has 60 whole months on 10 June 2026 (5 percent) and 59 the day before (nothing).
